from pydantic import BaseModel, Field
from typing import Literal

CaseType = Literal['民事案件', '执行案件', '行政案件']

class DocumentInfo(BaseModel):
    """One legal document: its title and the case type classification."""
    title: str | None = Field(description="The actual title of this judgment document as provided")
    case_type: CaseType | None = Field(description="The case category: 民事案件，执行案件，or 行政案件")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    documents: list[DocumentInfo]
